collective-collective:ashbyhq:06beca17-8.title: Account Executive
collective-collective:ashbyhq:06beca17-8.description: About the role: You’re an experienced sales professional with a consultative, value-based approach and are highly comfortable on video. Connecting with small business owners across industries comes naturally, and you genuinely enjoy building rapport and trust. You’ve also run high-velocity pipelines, often moving from first call to close in under seven days. You have a strong ability to translate complex business and financial concepts into clear, accurate, and compelling conversations. Thriving in fast-paced sales cycles, you’re comfortable juggling multiple requests while staying focused on driving toward solutions for your prospects. No two calls are ever the same, and that’s exactly what you love. Compensation for this role includes an $80k base salary with $160k OTE and uncapped commission potential. What you'll do: - Conduct video discovery with prospective members to determine qualification, initiate an exceptional relationship-building experience, and secure the prospect’s commitment to join. - Provide value and guidance to prospective members based on their unique business attributes and financial needs. - Own and manage a pipeline of both self-generated and pre-qualified leads through value-based, diligent follow-up. This includes calling, SMS, and email touchpoints. - Partner with Marketing and Enablement on outbound targeting and cold outreach. - Work collaboratively with Marketing and our Member Services Team on cross-functional projects to ensure the delivery of an exceptional member experience. (Setting client expectations, driving an amazing member experience) - Ambitiously develop and execute new ideas for outbound prospecting, pipeline management, and networking strategies. - Prepare and deliver weekly reports to explain business results (conversion, feedback, lead source, etc.). What you'll bring: - 2-3+ years experience at a FinTech company (or related SaaS experience), Client Acquisition, and Business Development Experience. - Consistent track record of overachieving sales quotas and targets. You’re really competitive and consistently need to be at the top of your team. - High EQ, passion for our mission, highly-engaged self-starter, proactive & independent learner - Empathic understanding of the challenges of being a small business owner. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills via phone, SMS, email, and video. - Exceptional organizational skills, data-centric approach, and attention to detail. - Proven ability to launch successful outreach or other prospecting campaigns. What we offer: - Remote-Friendly Environment: Flexibility to work from home while staying connected to the team - Health & Wellness: $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being - Time Off: Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays - Comprehensive Coverage: 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents - Parental Leave: 16 weeks fully paid - Retirement & Ownership: 401k plan plus an equity package - Team Connection: Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit #LI-Remote

distro-distro:lever:fe57b6a6-accc-4cb3-b.title: HCM Business Consultant - CA
distro-distro:lever:fe57b6a6-accc-4cb3-b.description: Position Summary The Business Consultant is responsible for identifying and cultivating new business opportunities through networking, channel partners and self-generated opportunities. This role involves executing aggressive prospecting strategies to gain access to key decision makers within a prospective client's organization. The Business Consultant maintains ownership of the entire sales cycle, including post-sale and implementation processes. Additionally, this role negotiates pricing and scope of service with prospective clients, completes required sales paperwork, and finalizes the terms of the client service agreement. The Business Consultant is also responsible for maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and forecast, and achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals as assigned by the sales leadership team. Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Proactively generate new business opportunities within the designated territory • Continuously expand knowledge of the industry trends, new products, services and Broker practices • Conduct thorough analysis, planning, and implementation of products and services tailored to meet client needs. • Stay informed about competitors' initiatives and analyze potential competitive threats • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and efficiency of all services provided to assigned clients • Schedule and conduct regular meetings with clients to address questions and concerns during the implementation phase • Collect and analyze data to provide strategic guidance on products, services, marketing, sales and other business areas • Prepare concise and impactful executive summaries for client presentations • Develop lead generation strategies and effectively use CRM (Salesforce) to track activities • Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales quotas • Complete and submit accurate new business paperwork, expense reports and weekly activity reports by the deadlines set by management • Participate in monthly consulting meetings and provide training and coaching to other team members • Frequent domestic travel will be required to attend team onsite meetings, client visits, customer events, industry conferences, and training sessions. This may include air travel, ground transportation (including cars, taxis, or rideshare services), and in some cases potential public transportation • Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients • Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department • Complete projects and other duties as assigned by supervisor Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities • Proactive and highly motivated individual with a strong focus on achieving new business goals • Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth and exceed sales targets • Exceptional negotiation and closing skills with the ability to influence key stakeholders • Understanding and consistent execution of sales methodologies, strategies, and best practices • Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and tools • In-depth understanding of the company's products or services • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration and presentations • Efficiently managing time to balance multiple clients and tasks, while staying organized in a dynamic work environment • Ability to define problems, collect and interpret data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions to perform key responsibilities • Ability to represent and display a professional style, pride and adhere to corporate policies and procedures. • Perform with sound business ethics and a high standard of performance while pursuing established goals • Uphold the highest standards of confidentiality and privacy in all aspects of the role • Flexibility to adjust strategies based on market changes and business need

Must have knowledge of all roof systems including applied Modified Bitumen, E.P.D.M., Heat Welded TPO/PVC Membranes, Tile, Coatings, Metal Roof systems, Sheet Metal and related roof accessories. This posting is for an existing vacancy within the organization.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:68d23234-2752-.title: Operations Supervisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:68d23234-2752-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in France. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. The role suits a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable managing people, monitoring performance, and addressing issues quickly. Strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail will be essential to keeping the operation running smoothly as it expands. Work closely with the Operations Manager to execute daily operational priorities and ensure activities remain aligned with broader business objectives. Manage and maintain an accurate roster of active agents, applying established policies to identify inactive agents and coordinate timely replacements. Monitor agent attendance and schedules to ensure team members consistently complete their required 8-hour daily shifts. Conduct daily test calls and quality checks to verify that agents meet established quality standards and operational expectations. Provide timely, constructive coaching and follow-up when quality issues, complaints, or performance concerns arise. Support workforce growth and capacity planning with the objective of building and maintaining a team of up to 100 active agents. Manage onboarding and compliance activities by reviewing required documentation, communicating status updates, and maintaining organized records. Calculate, prepare, and submit the operation’s monthly minutes-based invoice accurately and on time. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Requirements Demonstrated experience in operations, workforce management, team supervision, customer support, or a related operational environment. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. Performance-based bonus: 1% of the operation’s total gross monthly invoice. Bonus eligibility: The performance bonus becomes available once more than 20 active agents are maintained while completing their required 8-hour shifts. Growth-based earning potential: Compensation increases as the size and gross invoice value of the operation grows. Target earning example: At 100 active agents, the minimum gross monthly invoice is approximately $84,400, generating a minimum $844 performance bonus. jobgether-jobgether:lever:86f28225-f4c1-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:86f28225-f4c1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Israel. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e00ae3f2-b83d-.title: Finance Director
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e00ae3f2-b83d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Director based in the United States. This is a senior finance leadership opportunity focused on strengthening the financial health, transparency, and long-term sustainability of a mission-driven organization. The Finance Director will work closely with executive leadership, an outsourced CFO, and external accounting partners to oversee core financial operations. You will play a central role in budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, grant management, audit coordination, and compliance. The position offers broad visibility across departments and programs, with the opportunity to translate financial data into actionable insights. You will help ensure resources are managed responsibly while strengthening policies, controls, and financial processes. Success in this role requires a strategic mindset combined with strong attention to detail and hands-on financial expertise. This is a full-time remote position with occasional travel and meaningful influence across the organization. Collaborate with the outsourced CFO and accounting partner to prepare accurate and timely monthly financial statements and reporting packages. Conduct periodic budget audits and analyze budget-to-actual performance across the organization, programs, and departments. Support the CFO and participate in Audit and Finance Committee meetings, providing financial oversight, analysis, and reporting materials for the Board of Directors. Co-lead the annual budgeting process across departments and programs, ensuring budgets align with organizational priorities and available resources. Develop and monitor departmental and grant-specific budgets, providing ongoing financial oversight and variance analysis. Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities. Prepare and review monthly financial reports, including AP and AR reconciliations, cash flow reporting, statement of activities, and statement of financial position. Establish and maintain financial policies and procedures, including appropriate segregation of duties and controls designed to safeguard organizational assets. Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for the external accounting team and manage the ongoing partnership effectively. Ensure compliance with GAAP and nonprofit accounting standards, including applicable FASB requirements related to net asset classification. Track restricted and unrestricted funds and ensure appropriate allocation and use of resources. Co-manage grant and contract financial activities, ensuring restricted funds are used according to donor and grantor requirements, budgets are maintained, financial reports are prepared, and compliance obligations are met. Coordinate and co-manage the annual independent audit and support preparation and review of required IRS filings, including Form 990. Maintain compliance with applicable state charitable registration requirements and other relevant financial regulations. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field, with at least 10 years of relevant professional experience. Alternatively, a relevant master’s degree or CPA experience combined with approximately 5–7 years of applicable experience. Extensive knowledge of accounting principles, budgeting practices, financial policies, and financial reporting. Demonstrated experience overseeing accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Experience with nonprofit accounting, including restricted and unrestricted funds, grant accounting, GAAP, and applicable FASB standards. Familiarity with audit processes, regulatory compliance, and nonprofit tax requirements such as Form 990. Must have excellent guest service skills. Strong verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to work well under pressure. Must be available to work nights, weekends and holidays.
